title: Meet the Robot Parrot
story: Chilaka's cousin Gilaka can follow instructions, but only if they are exact. Your code is the map in its head.
goal: Learn the parrot's commands, then try the quick checks.

tests.label: Finish every try-it and quick check

hints: Read each block, then do the TRY IT and QUICK CHECK parts.
Every interactive block must be done to finish the lesson.
Take your time. Nothing here is timed.
socratic: Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the most useful thing you learned here?

blocks.text:
The parrot understands a few commands:

`move()` goes one step forward. `turn_left()` and `turn_right()` rotate on the spot. `pick_coin()` collects a coin on the current square.

It can also look around: `front_clear()` is True if the square ahead is free, and `at_goal()` is True on the flag.

blocks.q: The parrot faces east with a wall straight ahead. What does move() do?
options: It bumps and the program stops with an error
blocks.why: Walking into a wall is an error. Check front_clear() first.

blocks.q: Which command asks a question instead of doing something?
blocks.why: front_clear(), left_clear(), right_clear(), at_goal() and coin_here() all answer True or False.

blocks.q: Facing east, you call turn_right(). Which way does the parrot face now?
blocks.why: A right turn is clockwise: east becomes south.
